title: Runtime oncall scratchpad - Ishaan
text:
Morning quick dump (03/13/2026) - ongoing oncall/logs and experiments

Context: woke up to elevated error rate on prod-east for long-seq customer (seq len ~ 8192). Alerts pointed at model-serving worker restarts + tail OOMs. Was able to repro locally with --seq-length=8192 + quantized-8bit profile.

Immediate triage notes:
- Symptom: sudden spike in `cudaHostAlloc` failures, worker restart loop for processes pinned to GPU-3. Thundering after GC-heavy requests.
- Impact: 3 dedicated shards (dedicated-cust-7) experienced ~7% request failure rate for ~20 minutes. Autoscale didn't kick because reserved capacity flagged as full.
- Initial mitigation: temporarily route customer to model-variant: llama-2-70b-fp16-fallback (higher mem but more stable). Reduced failures to <0.5%.

Repro steps I ran locally (put here so I don't forget):
1) checkout sha: 8f7c1c3 (branch: ish/kernel-trace-wip)
2) build with CUDA 12.2 + ROCm off
3) run repro script: tools/repro/oom_long_seq.sh --model-path ./models/llama-2-70b-q8 --gpu 0 --seq 8192 --batch 1
4) tail logs: logs/runtime.log | grep "cudaHostAlloc"

Observations from local repro:
- KV-cache allocation pattern: lots of small host pinned allocations followed by sudden big allocation attempt (~1.9GB). Host pinned allocator fails because fragmentation + pinned pages limit hit.
- Kernel mix: fused-attn-v2 path seems to allocate temporary workspace on host for certain sequence boundary (check kernel: fused_attention_workspace()).
- When I switch to continuous-batching=false the failures drop (suggests batching machinery combined with KV caching triggers larger host allocations).

Hypothesis:
- Recent change in kernel selection (auto-select fused-attn-v2 for seq>=4096) plus continuous-batching prefetch is causing host pinned allocation spikes and fragmentation on some drivers/hardware combos.

Quick experiments run this morning:
- Force old-attn kernel: set env RUN_TIME_KERNEL_PREFER=old-attn -> repro disappears locally.
- Turn off KV prefetch: set PREFETCH_KV=0 -> repro disappears. Latency + cost increases, but stable.
- Patch candidate: within kernel selection add guard: if (driver==nvidia && seq>4096 && reservedPinnedPages<THRESH) prefer old-attn. Note: need safe check for reservedPinnedPages API availability on older drivers.

Work items / TODO (prioritized):
- [ ] Create hotfix PR that forces kernel fallback for affected hardware/driver combos (owner: Ishaan) - target: short-lived release to prod-east today if QA green.
- [ ] Add telemetry for pinned allocation failures (metrics + logs) so we can alert before request failures escalate (owner: Nora).
- [ ] Add a config knob to disable KV prefetch per-customer/route; expose as rollout option in Console (owner: Product + me for backend).
- [ ] Run full regression perf test across seq lengths [512,1024,2048,4096,8192] on GPU fleet image (owner: Samir) - block until we confirm there's no perf regression for 4096->8192 transitions.
- [ ] Follow up with infra to check host pinned pages default on our c6g/c7g instances + driver versions pinned (owner: infra).

Notes to self / smaller reminders:
- Add an integration test that emulates fragmentation by performing repeated small host pinned allocs + one big alloc. Can be flaky; keep it as synthetic perf test rather than unit.
- Check if k8s eviction/oom_score_adj is influencing the restart ordering for worker processes on GPU nodes.
- Remember to include a canary flag in rollout so Dedicated customers can opt in/out quickly.

Kernel-level scratch thoughts (brainstorm):
- Possible micro-optimization: reuse a per-worker host-pinned cache region for fused-attn workspace instead of repeated hostAlloc/free calls. Might reduce fragmentation. Con: fragile if other libs also pin/unpin.
- Consider moving fused-attn workspace to device memory when possible; cost: extra device memory pressure but avoids host pinning. Need to benchmark lat/throughput tradeoff.
- If we expose an env VAR to force workspace location (HOST/DEVICE/AUTO), ops could toggle per fleet.

Communication log (who I pinged / when):
- 08:27 AM: pinged #serving-runtime (thread) + @Nora for telemetry help.
- 08:35 AM: created JIRA-INF-3421 and linked repro logs.
- 09:10 AM: brief with Samir to run fleet smoke; agreed to run perf battery.
- 10:05 AM: routed customer to fallback model-variant; CS notified.

Quick draft of hotfix commit msg (for PR):
"runtime: add conservative kernel fallback for fused-attn on long sequences when host-pinned memory under-pressure

- Add runtime check for pinned-pages availability and fallback to old-attn when fragmentation risk high
- Instrument pinned allocation failures to metrics
- Add env var FORCE_KERNEL_SELECTION for testing

Resolves: JIRA-INF-3421"

Notes for post-mortem (to fill later):
- Timeline of alerts (attach exact timestamps + logs)
- Root cause: kernel selection heuristic + continuous batching + driver pinned-page limits
- Mitigation timeline + justification for routing customer to fallback
- Action items (above) with owners and SLAs for completion

Random TODOs (personal):
- [ ] Block out 2hrs tomorrow for kernel cleanup (refactor fused-attn workspace allocation)
- [ ] Draft a short doc for Console team: "How to configure route-level KV prefetch"
- [ ] Follow up with QA to add long-seq smoke to nightly regression (owner: QA lead)

End of dump. Will update as I make PRs / get infra answers.

-- Ishaan
